# Zepra Tech

> Zepra Tech is a US-based digital agency building websites, AI assistants, and growth marketing for US small businesses. Founded in 2025. US office in Middletown, Delaware, with an engineering studio in Lahore, Pakistan. Fixed prices from $1,500. Most websites launch in 2 to 3 weeks.

## About

## Services

- [Web Development](https://gozepra.tech/services/web-development): Full-stack websites, WordPress builds, Wix experiences, and custom business platforms designed for speed, trust, and conversion.
- [AI Agents / Bots](https://gozepra.tech/services/ai-agents-bots): Strategy, creation, and end-to-end deployment of AI assistants, business bots, and automation flows tailored to real operations.
- [Digital Marketing](https://gozepra.tech/services/digital-marketing): Meta Ads, Google Ads, and TikTok Ads campaigns focused on lead quality, sustainable acquisition, and stronger campaign performance.
- [Google My Business](https://gozepra.tech/services/google-my-business): Profile setup, optimization, and ongoing management to help local businesses improve visibility, credibility, and customer discovery.
- [Google AdSense](https://gozepra.tech/services/google-adsense): AdSense account setup and management with clean implementation, compliance awareness, and revenue-focused placement planning.
- [SEO / GEO / AEO](https://gozepra.tech/services/seo-geo-aeo): Search, generative engine, and answer engine optimization designed to strengthen discoverability across modern digital surfaces.
- [Content Writing & Blogging](https://gozepra.tech/services/content-writing-blogging): High-quality website copy, landing pages, articles, and blog content crafted to support authority, ranking, and conversion.
- [Ecommerce Solutions](https://gozepra.tech/services/ecommerce-solutions): Shopify, Amazon, eBay, Etsy, and WooCommerce solutions built for clean merchandising, smoother sales, and operational clarity.
- [Graphic Design](https://gozepra.tech/services/graphic-design): Branding systems, logo design, and polished visual assets that make businesses look more established and market-ready.
- [Video Editing](https://gozepra.tech/services/video-editing): Professional editing for marketing, brand storytelling, social content, and campaign assets that need a refined finish.
- [Customer Support / Service](https://gozepra.tech/services/customer-support-service): Reliable customer support structures and service handling that keep businesses responsive, organized, and client-friendly.
- [Cold Outreach](https://gozepra.tech/cold-outreaching): Precision B2B cold calling, SMS outreach, and high-deliverability email marketing powered by verified lead scraping and enterprise CRM pipelines.

## Pricing

- [Pricing](https://gozepra.tech/pricing): Launch from $1,500 one-time, up to 5 pages, launch in 2 to 3 weeks. Growth $3,000 to $8,000 one-time, adds an AI assistant, booking, CRM, and lead follow-up, launch in 3 to 4 weeks. Scale $8,000 to $18,000 one-time, custom platform or online store, launch in 6 to 8 weeks. Enterprise $18,000+, scoped per project. Every quote is fixed in writing before work starts.

## Process

- [About](https://gozepra.tech/about): Discovery, Strategy, Design, Development, Launch, then Growth and Support. The client approves scope and design before building starts.
